title: The Chaplet of Saint Michael
description: Chaplet to St. Michael and the nine choirs of angels · ~10 min

steps.title: Sign of the Cross

steps.versicle: O God, come to my assistance.
steps.response: O Lord, make haste to help me.

steps.versicle: Pray for us, O glorious Saint Michael, Prince of the Church of Jesus Christ.
steps.response: That we may be made worthy of His promises.

st_michael_salute_1.text: By the intercession of St. Michael and the celestial Choir of Seraphim, may the Lord make us worthy to burn with the fire of perfect charity. Amen.
st_michael_salute_1.source: The Chaplet of Saint Michael (approved by Pope Pius IX, 1851; traditional salutations of the Raccolta redaction)

st_michael_salute_2.text: By the intercession of St. Michael and the celestial Choir of Cherubim, may the Lord grant us the grace to leave the ways of sin and run in the paths of Christian perfection. Amen.
st_michael_salute_2.source: The Chaplet of Saint Michael (approved by Pope Pius IX, 1851; traditional salutations of the Raccolta redaction)

st_michael_salute_3.text: By the intercession of St. Michael and the celestial Choir of Thrones, may the Lord infuse into our hearts a true and sincere spirit of humility. Amen.
st_michael_salute_3.source: The Chaplet of Saint Michael (approved by Pope Pius IX, 1851; traditional salutations of the Raccolta redaction)

st_michael_salute_4.text: By the intercession of St. Michael and the celestial Choir of Dominions, may the Lord give us grace to govern our senses and overcome any unruly passions. Amen.
st_michael_salute_4.source: The Chaplet of Saint Michael (approved by Pope Pius IX, 1851; traditional salutations of the Raccolta redaction)

st_michael_salute_5.text: By the intercession of St. Michael and the celestial Choir of Virtues, may the Lord preserve us from evil and falling into temptation. Amen.
st_michael_salute_5.source: The Chaplet of Saint Michael (approved by Pope Pius IX, 1851; traditional salutations of the Raccolta redaction)

st_michael_salute_6.text: By the intercession of St. Michael and the celestial Choir of Powers, may the Lord protect our souls against the snares and temptations of the devil. Amen.
st_michael_salute_6.source: The Chaplet of Saint Michael (approved by Pope Pius IX, 1851; traditional salutations of the Raccolta redaction)

st_michael_salute_7.text: By the intercession of St. Michael and the celestial Choir of Principalities, may God fill our souls with a true spirit of obedience. Amen.
st_michael_salute_7.source: The Chaplet of Saint Michael (approved by Pope Pius IX, 1851; traditional salutations of the Raccolta redaction)

st_michael_salute_8.text: By the intercession of St. Michael and the celestial Choir of Archangels, may the Lord give us perseverance in faith and in all good works in order that we may attain the glory of Heaven. Amen.
st_michael_salute_8.source: The Chaplet of Saint Michael (approved by Pope Pius IX, 1851; traditional salutations of the Raccolta redaction)

st_michael_salute_9.text: By the intercession of St. Michael and the celestial Choir of Angels, may the Lord grant us to be protected by them in this mortal life and conducted in the life to come to Heaven. Amen.
st_michael_salute_9.source: The Chaplet of Saint Michael (approved by Pope Pius IX, 1851; traditional salutations of the Raccolta redaction)

st_michael_chaplet_closing.text: O glorious Prince Saint Michael, chief and commander of the heavenly hosts, guardian of souls, vanquisher of rebel spirits, servant in the house of the Divine King, and our admirable guide: thou who shinest with excellence and superhuman virtue, deliver us from all evil who turn to thee with confidence, and enable us by thy gracious protection to serve God more and more faithfully every day. Amen.
st_michael_chaplet_closing.source: The Chaplet of Saint Michael (approved by Pope Pius IX, 1851; traditional salutations of the Raccolta redaction); concluding prayer

st_michael_chaplet_collect.text: Almighty and everlasting God, Who, by a prodigy of goodness and a merciful desire for the salvation of all men, hast appointed the most glorious Archangel Saint Michael Prince of Thy Church: make us worthy, we beseech Thee, to be delivered from all our enemies, that none of them may harass us at the hour of death, but that we may be conducted by him into Thy presence. This we ask through the merits of Jesus Christ our Lord. Amen.
st_michael_chaplet_collect.source: The Chaplet of Saint Michael (approved by Pope Pius IX, 1851; traditional salutations of the Raccolta redaction); closing collect

glory_be.text:
Glory be to the Father,
and to the Son,
and to the Holy Spirit,
as it was in the beginning,
is now, and ever shall be,
world without end.
Amen.
glory_be.latin:
Gloria Patri, et Filio,
et Spiritui Sancto,
sicut erat in principio,
et nunc, et semper,
et in saecula saeculorum.
Amen.

schedule_note.note: The Chaplet of Saint Michael as received: the invitatory ("O God, come to my assistance") with the Glory Be; nine salutations, one for each choir of angels in descending order, each praying the salutation text, one Our Father, and three Hail Marys (nine BeadGroupStep groups of 3); then four Our Fathers in honor of Saint Michael, the Guardian Angels, Saint Gabriel, and Saint Raphael; finally the received closing prayer, versicle, and collect. The available-daily anchor is the evening hour (19:00), leaving the wall-clock free of the app’s shared Angelus/Mercy anchor hours. The brief’s "9 salutes + 4 Our Fathers" is honored; the salutations carry the received Raccolta texts.
schedule_note.structure: sign of the cross; invitatory with Glory Be; 9 salutations (salutation + 1 Our Father + 3 Hail Marys); 4 Our Fathers for the angelic names; closing prayer, versicle, collect
schedule_note.invocation_source: The Chaplet of Saint Michael (approved by Pope Pius IX, 1851; traditional salutations of the Raccolta redaction)
